roll_call: I have come. No country can endure by clinging to obsolete institutions.
I will not confine Confucius to antiquity. I will illuminate his teaching for this age.
I have seen the people's suffering. Reform must now answer it.
deploy: Do not settle for partial measures. Reform the disease at its root.
Build schools and gather talent. Learning is the foundation of reform.
Study the reforms of Japan and Russia, then choose what fits China.
battle_win: Because we changed, we endured. Today's gains came from institutions set in motion.
We opened the gates of learning. More talent will now renew the country.
We crossed one boundary. Great Unity begins with advances like this.
battle_draw: Limited reform is not enough. The roots of the old institutions remain.
My purpose is unbroken. I will read the times and submit the next memorial.
Great Unity does not arrive in a day. First, we must prepare the age of peace.
battle_lose: Though reform has stopped, the principle remains: change is the price of survival.
If the age is not ready, I will prepare students to carry the reform forward.
Borders of state and class create suffering. I will continue to imagine a wider world.
clash_attack: Sweep away the old laws and establish new institutions!
Open the schools and place talent at the front!
Cross the barriers of state and class, and advance toward Great Unity!

roll_call: I am here. Obsolete institutions cannot preserve a country.
Confucius does not belong to antiquity. His teaching must speak now.
I have seen the people's suffering. Change the institutions.
deploy: Stop patching the edges. Treat the disease at its root.
Build schools and gather talent. Learning comes before reform.
Study Japan and Russia, then choose what fits China.
battle_win: We changed the institutions and preserved the country.
Open the schools, and talent will come.
One step forward has opened the road to Great Unity.
battle_draw: Small repairs are not enough. The old roots remain.
My purpose holds. Read the times and submit another memorial.
Great Unity takes time. Prepare the age of peace first.
battle_lose: The reform stopped, but survival still demands change.
If the age is not ready, train students to carry the reform.
Cross state and class. Keep seeking Great Unity.
clash_attack: Clear the old laws and build new institutions!
Open the schools and put talent first!
Cross every barrier toward Great Unity!

roll_call: I am here. Government must first secure the people's livelihood.
Just as Bao Shu recognized me, I will recognize those fit to serve.
I am Yiwu of Qi. I offer a plan to enrich the state and strengthen its forces.
deploy: Set farming and commerce in their proper places, then organize the ranks.
Regulate prices and release concentrated wealth back to the people.
Uphold the Zhou king and unite the lords. Establish legitimacy first.
battle_win: We filled the granaries and fed the people. Propriety will follow.
We turned defeat into achievement. Fortune can still be drawn from disaster.
This was not one man's work. Bao Shu deserves credit for recognizing talent.
battle_draw: Though we did not win, we must protect the people's livelihood first.
I will find where the grain has accumulated. Hoarded wealth leaves people hungry.
I will ask why the soldiers should move, then reset rewards and punishments.
battle_lose: My plan fell short. I will rebuild the treasury and the people's livelihood first.
The four pillars of propriety, duty, integrity, and shame have weakened. I will restore them.
A path remains to turn defeat into achievement. I will withdraw and reckon again.
clash_attack: Order the ranks and close every gap!
Guard the supply line and release the stored grain!
Unite the lords and strike at one point!
